newsitem.title: USA: CNA, Capsure merger makes sense - analyst.
newsitem.headline: CNA, Capsure merger makes sense - analyst.

text.p: The merger between CNA Financial Corp and Capsure Holdings Corp should benefit both companies, an analyst said Thursday.

"A large, well-funded company like CNA can take Capsure's expertise in the surety business and really expand it throughout the country," said Gary Prestopino, an analyst at Mesirow Financial. "(Buying Capsure) is a really low risk compared to other players in the insurance industry."
CNA and Capsure announced late Thursday they will form a new company called CNA Surety Corp, which they said will be the largest surety company in the United States.
"This is a very attractive business considering Capsure's national presence," Prestopino said. Capsure owns two companies, Western Surety and Universal Surety of America.

The definitive agreement calls for CNA, through its subsidiaries, to receive 61.75 percent of the common stock of CNA Surety. The remaining 38.25 percent will be split between current Capsure shareholders and option holders. Current Capsure option holders will receive equivalent options on CNA Surety stock, the companies said.
Other financial terms, including the total value of the deal, were not dicslosed.

Mark Vonnahme, the head of CNA's surety operation, will become president and chief executive officer of CNA Surety, the comapnies said. Key members of CNA's and Capsure's management teams will also remain in place.
"The surety business is very people-intensive," Prestopino said, "so the new company will most likely look to back-office savings when it comes to staffing."

In a prepared statement, CNA and Capsure said the merger presents "significant opportunities for expense savings" over the next two or three years as redundant operations are eliminated. However, a CNA spokesman told Reuters there are no personnel eliminations anticipated at this time.
CNA Financial, the parent company of the CNA insurance companies, is one of the ten largest U.S. insurance organizations. Capsure Holdings Corp. provides surety and fidelity bonds in 50 states.
